GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then worked up and Settled Down 2nd 1 length Two Wide , took lead at 1250m and crossed at 1200m, Headed 600m and Drifted Back to 3 Lengths rail turning, dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed bilateral epistaxis (first time). provisions of AR79(4) invoked.] # Bled. 3-month ban.
Jumped Ok worked hard to find lead. led turn. battled on well # worked early

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, railed up to trail just under 2 Lengths turning, moved through to 2nd place in Straight while watching the winner stride well clear # winner far too good
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , passed one runner to 5 Lengths Four Wide turning, dropped off in Straight # slow out then Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Settled Down between rivals Two Wide 3 Lengths (800m), just dropped back a little before Turn , Straightened Up trying to raise an effort, held Ground to the line (front pads & pre race ear muffs off 1st time/ Blinkers First Time ) # couldn't run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5l Settled Down 3rd last 6 Lengths 600m 8th 6 Lengths home turn 7th 4 Lengths no run on Straight # average effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok rails gate drifting back Soon After though balanced up second last 8-9 Lengths (700m), Under Whip for home work to do, made no real headway (Pads (Front) FIRST TIME) # back/no factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Approaching the 900m, raced in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide Lead settling down, Headed 850m then held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , kept battling in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed it to be lame in the near foreleg. Vet clearance required.] # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the filly was lame in the near fore (2/5). Trainer was advised a veterinary certificate would be required prior to next trial/ race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced 2nd last 3 Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same ntil pushed to chase Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 200m & made ground in last 100m. # Good last 150m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in under pressure over the final 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 7 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was contacted by rnr which was bumped and taken out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. First start: Need to see again. (Cross-over Nose Band, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) & Lugging Bit -All- FIRST TIME) # weakened noticeably
